215. Reunion with the Gods (5)
As soon as Tujard embedded the sphere into his body, the scenery of the space began to change.
The storm became even more severe, and the aura of thunderbolts and lightning thickened. The wounds on Tujard's body were also streaming with this aura instead of blood.
Jin was becoming frustrated.
'Could Gram's energy be utilized like this?'

Jin hadn't considered using Gram's energy when he had come looking for Paytel. He hadn't heard the conversation between Murakan and Paytel because he had been occupied with Tujard, so he only just found out that Gram's energy existed in a form that could be used.
That's why he was annoyed. In a situation where every bit of help is needed to fight the golden fleet and liberate Lapharosa, it was infuriating to see Tujard use this resource now.
Kaiman, Trax, Lujeen, and Chin stared at Tujard with vacant expressions.
'What kind of madness is this, dying alone when we all should escape together?'

'Even if we were to recover Gram's energy and escape, why would you ruin things further, Tujard? You were entrusted with full authority because you were the strongest among us, and assumed you also had judgement to match...!'
Even Trax, known as the mad dog, couldn't comprehend Tujard's decision and screamed in frustration.
'It's my first time using the power of a god. But I don't think that by using this power, I can defeat you. However, the fact that the time I can enjoy the pleasure has increased is worth it.'
Tujard was a real madman. He was a man who cared not about the outcome of a fight, but how much fun he could have in it.
"Looking at you talking about immortality over there, it seems you've made such a promise, but you're willing to forsake it just for the pleasure? Even though you're certain you can't win?"
'Don't you have that kind of experience? Even though you knew you would lose, even though you knew you would die, you still went to fight.'
Of course, Jin had several such experiences.
But he never did it for personal pleasure. He always made that choice to uphold his beliefs, for the people behind him.
"Well, each person has different thoughts and values. But pushing your allies into a corner for your own amusement is not a very commendable thing to do. Not to mention, damaging something I need."
Jin's eyes sharpened. The specters felt a chilling aura emanating from him, causing their skin to tingle.
"Luna, Runtia."
"What should we do?"
"Finish off the ones you're dealing with as quickly as possible and join me. I think we've seen enough of these old swords."
Luna and Runtia nodded their heads. Energy, along with magic, filled the Crantel and the Axe Sword.
"Hey Murakan, shouldn't you step in too? Gram's energy is not something easily encountered. I think you're taking things a bit too lightly."
At the worried words uttered by Paytel, Murakan chuckled.
"If Gram himself was here, then we should act as you suggest. But if it's just leftover energy making someone stronger, it's meaningless."
It's meaningless.
As Murakan said, Jin and the knights truly thought so.
If Tujard had broken his own wall during the battle and gained enlightenment, there would have been a need to worry, but the mere enhancement of strength was not threatening at all.
Even so, the reason Jin told the knights to finish quickly and join was to suppress Tujard's pleasure as much as possible.
Swoosh!
Crantel cut off Trax's right arm and left a gash. Kaiman and Trax were even more shrunk due to Gram's energy radiating from Tujard.

"Trax, I wanted to inflict more pain on you. The sin of daring to harm the children of Runkandel cannot be erased even after two thousand years, not two hundred. But since you didn't attain immortality, you will inevitably continue to suffer somewhere after today."
Choked, Trax couldn't utter more than that single word before his throat fell silent. Then Luna finished off the remaining Kaiman and shook off the blood that had stuck to Crantel.
Lujeen and Chin also had no more strength left to resist Runtia.

Even though they had exchanged blows a few times before, and even landed critical hits on Runtia, those too had no impact. The fighter called Kurano's barrier, and the legend known as the fist emperor, neither could even scratch Runtia's strong body.

"You should have been satisfied to raise your name in a good era and die, I don't understand why you would want to suffer this kind of disgrace by coming back to life. I bear no ill will, but not stepping back when our wine was offered initially was an insult to Runkandel. The price for that is death."
With Charle's blade, the lives of Lujeen and Chin were cut short as well.
The only one left was Tujard, who had been strengthened by Gram's energy. Jin was already putting pressure on him, unfolding his God Slayer Technique.
'Tujard doesn't know how to use the energy at all. But this destructive power... It would be great if we could retrieve the sphere and save this energy.'
With Luna and Runtia joining in, the picture that Tujard had wanted was bound to be shattered.
He wanted to meet his end in a one-on-one duel with Jin, exchanging heavy blows. Not being slashed randomly by Siegmund, Crantel, and Charle.
Phaitel was shocked once again, watching the three overpowering Twizard.
["...I'm sure the energy of my brother amplified that bug to its limits. How can this be?"]

"The little guy could've beaten that Twizard in 10 minutes by himself. The guy I killed before, Atilla, had some pride, but this one's childish. Pleasure this, pleasure that, whatever the case, he needs to get hit."
Moreover, Jin didn't even use secret techniques like the Sword of King or the Demonic Sword.

Because the opponent wasn't worth showing such a sword. The landscape of the space, ferociously transformed as if the Thunder God had descended, and Twizard, whose form changed as if he was from the Demon King's tribe because of Gram's energy, all looked utterly pathetic in front of Jin and his knights.
Twizard had given up even on immortality to fight happily.
Jin, Luna, and Luntia were merely 'doing their job' with emotionless faces. Hence, in the battle against Twizard, Luna and Luntia held more stake than Jin.
After all, it was the job of the knights to follow the orders of the lord.
["Keheuk…!"]
In the end, Luna and Luntia perfectly suppressed Twizard before even 5 minutes had passed and made him kneel in front of Jin.
There was no more madness of a man intoxicated with pleasure on Twizard's face. He wasn't filled with regret either, but rather looked desolate at the much more pathetic outcome than expected.
"You can now put down the title of God of War and disappear as you wished."
As Jin reached for the sphere embedded in Twizard's chest, Twizard looked up at him.
["...You need Gram's energy, I guess?"]
"That's right."
["This device has already perfectly assimilated with me. If you force it out, it will be destroyed."]
"Is there a way to remove it without harming it?"
["If you make one agreement with me, I'll disengage the assimilation myself and give it to you."]
"What do you want?"
["Promise me, stake the honor of the lord of Runecandle. If I hand over this sword, you'll fight me one-on-one, very seriously. That's enough for me."]
"You really are a strange senior."
Jin had to accept the proposal.
He couldn't trust Twizard, but fighting him one-on-one wasn't that hard, so he thought it's a break-even at worst.
Of course, he felt uncomfortable. He couldn't shake the feeling of being used for Twizard's pleasure.
But just as Jin was about to nod, Phaitel quickly ran to Jin's side and took his place.
["Hmm, Jin! There's no need to listen to that bug's request.]
"Phaitel?"

[I can retrieve the item containing my brother's energy. The reason I could hide here in the first place is because I can mimic my brother's energy, so let me recover it properly and hand it over to you.]
Phaitel had been changing his mind while watching Jin and his party fight.
At first, he was annoyed that he had sworn to help Jin using the seal, but upon reconsideration, this was a situation where good fortune had come rolling in.

['I have to keep the promise because of the seal anyway. But if I fall out of favor with these guys, I'll be helpless. Since Jiffle has cast a concealment, if I can't get help from the Runecandle and Barmel alliance, I won't be able to avoid annihilation.']

His dignity as a god was already shattered back when Jin was a trainee knight at Bluebird Highway. Phaitel concluded that to secure Jin's protection in the future, he had to prove that he was somewhat useful.
[Phaitel, what the hell is this bastard saying…!]
[Where is the bug shouting? Did you think I would believe your nonsense about controlling my brother's power? Daring to deceive our Barmel alliance leader?]
"...Our Barmel alliance?"

[Weren't Julian and Kaltor in the Barmel alliance, so didn't I naturally become a member? If not, let me know the official procedure. I'll sincerely follow it. I've decided to join your side from now on. That is, if you forget about the past and just accept me.]
Julian and Kaltor could only lower their heads in embarrassment for some reason.
Jin, seeing through Phaitel's intentions, smiled slyly.
"Well thought, Phaitel. No, Lord Phaitel. From now on, Lord Phaitel is officially a god affiliated with the alliance. Let's bury the past. How do you plan to extract Gram's energy?"

[Just suppress this bug for about an hour like this, and I can safely extract it. I don't need Jiffle's disgusting device. I just need to create a vessel right now and put it there. You know Brain Palace Harmila, right? Compared to making such a weapon, this is a very simple task.]
[Shut up, Phaitel! Why are you messing things up all of a sudden!]

[Then should I do a good job for you bugs who were just about to kill me? It's right to sincerely help our leader who saved me. Shut up and stay still, once I've extracted all of my brother's energy, the leader will surely annihilate you.]
As Jin accepted Phaitel's opinion, Twizard eventually lost his reason and raged in vain. However, he couldn't even budge because of Luna and Luntia's grip on him.
Soon, Phaitel sat down in front of Twizard and gave Jin a thumbs up.

[From what I heard, it seems my ability to materialize divine power is needed, so let's try making anything in the future. I'm counting on you, leader! And Murakan and Luna, Luntia, and other bugs... no, friends.]
The reunion full of ill fate with the god ended up taking a dramatic turn and concluded.
